header.name: Never Lost
header.description: v1.0.0 - Dropped netherite and anything enchanted with Mending never despawn, and optionally neither do items you have renamed.

settings.text: §l§aNever Lost§r - dropped items that would normally vanish after five minutes stay where they fell.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r
§7Every netherite item: tools, weapons, armour, horse and nautilus armour, ancient debris, scrap, ingots, blocks and the upgrade template.§r
§7Any item enchanted with Mending, whatever it is made of.§r
§7Any item given a name at an anvil, whatever it is made of. Off by default: a renamed stack of dirt would never go away either.§r
